build_gpc_xor_classification: build a Gaussian process classifier on XOR data using RBF and DotProduct kernels
create_gpc_with_rbf_kernel: create a GaussianProcessClassifier with an RBF kernel for stationary isotropic classification
create_gpc_with_dotproduct_kernel: create a GaussianProcessClassifier with a squared DotProduct kernel for non-stationary classification
train_gpc_classifier: train a GaussianProcessClassifier by fitting it with feature matrix X and labels Y
predict_gpc_probabilities: predict class probabilities using GaussianProcessClassifier.predict_proba on a grid of points
